raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Add concise Dynamo sidecar guidance to the DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash recipe, covering the gRPC connection, parsing, KV events and frontend. Use the existing command builder for checkpoint, hardware and parallelism choices.

## Claims

- Replace the deployment-specific walkthrough with a short integration guide and links to Dynamo's maintained launch examples.
- Remove pinned containers, package versions, fabric setup, benchmark profiles and workload-specific wording from this recipe.
- Retain the prefill sidecar's `--component prefill` setting. Command-builder settings are unchanged.

## Validation

- `node scripts/validate-source.mjs --source vllm --dir <checkout>/recipes`: passed, 215 models.
- `pre-commit run --files recipes/models/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash.yaml`: passed.
- All seven documented Bash blocks passed `bash -n`; the sidecar KV-event JSON parsed successfully.
- Parsed YAML comparison confirmed that command-builder fields are unchanged. The local recipe page rendered the revised section successfully.
- The original checkpoint's deployment evidence remains [InferenceX #4231](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4231), [run 39112710364](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/39112710364) at `5fafe8ccb7e4a849eadaea7703456cb0f950f89b`. This documentation revision adds no GPU validation or claim for the builder's newer 1017 checkpoint.

## Details

The guide now explains the sidecar interface without duplicating deployment orchestration and workload-specific tuning. Dynamo's own guide owns runtime installation and complete topology examples. This adds model-specific parser and checkpoint guidance missing from the existing builder; the separate B200 tuning PR #62541 covers different settings.

AI assistance was used: Codex revised the documentation, checked review feedback and ran local validation, using vLLM's `/pr-checklist` skill.

<summary>中文</summary>

为 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 配方补充简洁的 Dynamo sidecar 指南，说明 gRPC 连接、推理与工具调用解析、KV 事件及前端启动。checkpoint、硬件和并行方式继续由现有命令生成器选择。

删除固定容器及软件包版本、网络安装步骤、基准测试配置矩阵和专用工作负载表述，改为链接 Dynamo 维护的完整部署示例。保留预填充 sidecar 的 `--component prefill` 设置，命令生成器配置未变。

配方校验（215 个模型）、pre-commit、七个 Bash 代码块的语法检查、KV 事件 JSON 解析及本地页面渲染均通过。原 checkpoint 的公开部署证据仍适用；本次文档修改没有新增 GPU 验证，也不声称验证了默认的 1017 checkpoint。独立的 B200 调优 PR #62541 覆盖不同设置。Codex 参与了文档修改与验证，并执行了 vLLM 的 `/pr-checklist` 检查。

</details>

- [x] **Code Quality and Style:** Keeps code and comments clear and concise, and updates relevant documentation and examples.

👋 Hi! Thank you for contributing to the vLLM project.

💬 Join our developer Slack at https://slack.vllm.ai to discuss your PR in `#pr-reviews`, coordinate on features in `#feat-` channels, or join special interest groups in `#sig-` channels.

PRs do not trigger a full CI run by default. Reviewers with write access and configured trusted contributors can comment `/ci run` for upstream CI or `/amd-ci run` for AMD CI only whenever CI signals are needed.

Once the PR is approved or has the `ready` label, the PR author can also use the corresponding `/ci run`, `/ci retry`, and `/ci cancel` commands, or their `/amd-ci` variants. New commits do not start upstream CI automatically.

If you have any questions, please reach out to us on Slack at https://slack.vllm.ai.

ℹ️ This PR is 10 commits behind upstream `main`. Merged upstream `main` into this branch as `0c90b5fbf9d8` before starting CI. Pull the branch before pushing more changes.

## Claude Code Review

This pull request is from a fork — automated review is disabled. A repository maintainer can comment `@claude review` to run a one-time review.

[by Claude Code] Thanks for putting this together, it's a very thorough write-up! I compared it against InferenceX #4231 at `5fafe8cc` (agg and disagg recipes, master entries, and the engine and sidecar launch lines from run 39112710364). Every engine flag, JSON config, environment variable, profile, image and Dynamo version matches. One small launch difference is noted inline: the prefill sidecar's `--component prefill`.

[by Claude Code] The InferenceX run behind this (#4231, [run 39112710364](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/39112710364)) launches each prefill sidecar with `--component prefill` as well:

```
python3 -m dynamo.vllm.sidecar --grpc-endpoint 127.0.0.1:19000 --disaggregation-mode prefill --component prefill ...
```

Decode keeps the default component. Suggest matching it so prefill engines register where the decode side looks for them:

```suggestion
      SIDECAR_ARGS=(--disaggregation-mode prefill --component prefill)
```

+  ## B300 Dynamo sidecar deployment
+
+  This deployment uses the original [DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash checkpoint](https://huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash),

+  revision `5fafe8ccb7e4a849eadaea7703456cb0f950f89b`. The commands below are a
+  separate deployment from the builder's vLLM/SMG strategies: each engine runs
+  `vllm-rs serve`, with a colocated Dynamo gRPC sidecar and a shared KV-aware frontend.
+  Both aggregated TP4 and disaggregated DEP2-prefill/DEP8-decode layouts use
+  five-token probabilistic DSpark with block rejection and adaptive verification disabled.
+
+  ### Runtime and fabric prerequisites
+
+  Use `vllm/vllm-openai:nightly-x86_64-dev-20261012-59e75f4` on x86-64 B300 nodes.
+  Stage the original checkpoint on every worker and mount it at `/model`.
+  Reserve host memory for Engram weight offload; the frontend also budgets 8 GB
+  for its tokenizer cache. Each DEP2 prefill engine additionally reserves
+  75,161,927,680 bytes (70 GiB) per DP rank for lazy CPU KV offload.
+  Use host networking, sufficient shared memory, GPU access, and the host's EFA
+  devices in every worker container. Host EFA drivers must already be installed.
+  Install the matching Dynamo packages in the serving container without replacing vLLM:
+
+  ```bash
+  uv pip install --system --extra-index-url https://pypi.nvidia.com \
+    ai-dynamo-runtime==1.6.0.dev20261010 ai-dynamo==1.6.0.dev20261010
+  ```
+
+  For disaggregation, use [AWS EFA installer 1.50.0](https://efa-installer.amazonaws.com/aws-efa-installer-1.50.0.tar.gz)'s Ubuntu 24.04 x86-64
+  userspace packages (archive SHA256
+  `fa6dff8593d866866c13cb4640d9059835cd4efa427971f100ab40c97bef2841`).
+  Install `udev`, `libhwloc15`, the installer's `rdma-core` packages
+  (`libibverbs1`, `ibverbs-providers`, `libibumad3`, `librdmacm1`, `rdma-core`),
+  `libfabric1-aws`, and `libfabric-aws-bin`. Make `/opt/amazon/efa/lib`
+  visible to the dynamic linker and run `ldconfig`. If the NIXL LIBFABRIC
+  plugin requires `libcudart.so.12`, install `nvidia-cuda-runtime-cu12` and
+  expose that package's library directory to the linker as well.
+  Check `ldd` on `libplugin_LIBFABRIC.so` and run
+  `/opt/amazon/efa/bin/fi_info -p efa` in each container before launch.
+  See the [AWS EFA installation guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/efa-start.html).
+
+  ### Discovery and frontend
+
+  Provide a shared etcd endpoint. For a single-member service, set `INFRA_IP`
+  to its reachable host address and run an installed `etcd` binary:
+
+  ```bash
+  etcd --data-dir ./etcd-data --listen-client-urls http://0.0.0.0:2379 \
+    --advertise-client-urls "http://$INFRA_IP:2379"
+  ```
+
+  Set these values in every frontend and worker shell, substituting the etcd host:
+
+  ```bash
+  export ETCD_ENDPOINTS=http://ETCD_HOST:2379
+  export DYN_REQUEST_PLANE=tcp DYN_EVENT_PLANE=zmq PYTHONHASHSEED=0
+  ```
+
+  Run one frontend. Keep a stable `X-Dynamo-Session-ID` HTTP header across
+  turns of the same conversation to use the four-hour session affinity:
+
+  ```bash
+  export DYN_ROUTER_TEMPERATURE=0 DYN_LOG=warn
+  unset DYN_ROUTER_QUEUE_THRESHOLD
+  export DYN_TOKENIZER=fastokens DYN_TOKENIZER_CACHE=1
+  export DYN_TOKENIZER_CACHE_BYTES=8000000000
+  export DYN_ROUTER_ACTIVE_REQUEST_EXPIRY_SECS=3600
+  export DYN_TCP_CHANNEL_BUFFER=128 DYN_TCP_REQUEST_TIMEOUT=60
+  uv run --no-project python -m dynamo.frontend --http-port 8000 \
+    --router-mode kv --router-session-affinity-ttl-secs 14400
+  ```

+  The active-decode/prefill admission thresholds are unset in this deployment.
+  For disaggregation, the frontend can share the first decode host; give it a

+  `agg-batch` sets 32 maximum sequences and an 8192-token budget. Both use four GPUs.

+  the same prefill settings. Place up to four independent DEP2 prefill engines
+  on an eight-GPU node. `pd-5` needs a second prefill node for its fifth engine,
+  plus the separate eight-GPU decode node.
+
+  ### Launch an engine and its sidecar
+
+  In a worker shell, source the common discovery exports and the following
+  role-specific environment. Aggregated workers need:
+
+  ```bash
+  export VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER='1'
+  export VLLM_ENGINE_READY_TIMEOUT_S='7200'
+  ```
+
+  Both disaggregated roles additionally need:
+
+  ```bash
+  export VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER='1'
+  export VLLM_ENGINE_READY_TIMEOUT_S='7200'
+  export VLLM_RPC_TIMEOUT='600000'
+  export VLLM_ALLREDUCE_USE_SYMM_MEM='0'
+  export VLLM_RANDOMIZE_DP_DUMMY_INPUTS='1'
+  export NCCL_CUMEM_ENABLE='1'
+  export UCX_TLS='cuda_copy,cuda_ipc,srd,tcp'
+  export UCX_MEMTYPE_CACHE='n'
+  export UCX_MEMTYPE_REG_WHOLE='n'
+  export UCX_RNDV_PIPELINE_ERROR_HANDLING='y'
+  export UCX_MODULE_DIR='/usr/local/lib/python3.12/dist-packages/nixl_cu13.libs/ucx'
+  export NIXL_UCX_SGL_ENABLE='0'
+  export FI_PROVIDER='efa'
+  export FI_EFA_USE_DEVICE_RDMA='1'
+  export FI_EFA_FORK_SAFE='1'
+  export DYN_SIDECAR_GRPC_STARTUP_DEADLINE_SECS='9000'

+  its equivalent rather than using a host UCX installation.

+  For each independent engine, set `ROLE` (`agg`, `prefill`, or `decode`),
+  `PROFILE`, `ENGINE_IP` (that engine's reachable host IP), `INSTANCE`
+  (0–3, unique among engines on one host), and `CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES`.
+  An aggregated engine uses `0,1,2,3`; a prefill engine uses one disjoint pair
+  (`0,1`, `2,3`, `4,5`, or `6,7`); decode uses all eight GPUs.
+  Each engine has its own RPC, KV-event, NIXL, HTTP and gRPC ports.
+  Keep those ports reachable between worker and frontend hosts.
+
+  Run this block once per engine, in its own shell:
+
+  ```bash
+  set -eo pipefail
+  : "${ROLE:?Set ROLE}" "${PROFILE:?Set PROFILE}" "${ENGINE_IP:?Set ENGINE_IP}"
+  : "${INSTANCE:?Set INSTANCE}" "${CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES:?Set CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES}"
+  case "$ROLE:$PROFILE" in
+    agg:agg-*|prefill:pd-*|decode:pd-*) ;;
+    *) echo "ROLE and PROFILE must select the same deployment" >&2; exit 1 ;;
+  esac
+  source worker-args.sh
+  source profiles.sh
+  export DYN_SYSTEM_PORT=$((7500 + INSTANCE))
+  export VLLM_NIXL_SIDE_CHANNEL_HOST="$ENGINE_IP"
+  export VLLM_NIXL_SIDE_CHANNEL_PORT=$((5400 + INSTANCE))
+  export DYN_VLLM_KV_EVENT_PORT=$((5200 + INSTANCE))
+  export VLLM_PLUGINS=
+  grpc_port=$((19000 + INSTANCE))
+  http_port=$((6100 + INSTANCE))
+  rpc_port=$((8400 + INSTANCE))
+  export VLLM_PORT=$((20000 + INSTANCE))
+  events=$(printf '{"publisher":"zmq","topic":"kv-events","enable_kv_cache_events":true,"endpoint":"tcp://%s:%s"}' "$ENGINE_IP" "$DYN_VLLM_KV_EVENT_PORT")
+  SIDECAR_ARGS=()
+  case "$ROLE" in
+    agg)
+      ROLE_ARGS=("${AGG_ARGS[@]}" "${PROFILE_ARGS[@]}" --kv-events-config "$events")
+      deadline=3600 ;;
+    prefill)
+      ROLE_ARGS=("${PD_ARGS[@]}" "${PREFILL_ARGS[@]}"
+        --data-parallel-size-local 2 --data-parallel-address "$ENGINE_IP"
+        --data-parallel-rpc-port "$rpc_port" --kv-events-config "$events")
+      SIDECAR_ARGS=(--disaggregation-mode prefill)

## Overview

Add concise Dynamo sidecar guidance to the DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash recipe, covering the gRPC connection, parsing, KV events and frontend. Use the existing command builder for checkpoint, hardware and parallelism choices.

## Claims

- Replace the deployment-specific walkthrough with a short integration guide and links to Dynamo's maintained launch examples.
- Remove pinned containers, package versions, fabric setup, benchmark profiles and workload-specific wording from this recipe.
- Retain the prefill sidecar's `--component prefill` setting. Command-builder settings are unchanged.

- `node scripts/validate-source.mjs --source vllm --dir <checkout>/recipes`: passed, 215 models.
- `pre-commit run --files recipes/models/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash.yaml`: passed.

- Parsed YAML comparison confirmed that command-builder fields are unchanged. The local recipe page rendered the revised section successfully.

This documentation revision adds no GPU validation or claim for the builder's newer 1017 checkpoint.

+  ## Dynamo sidecar serving
+
+  Dynamo can route requests to vLLM's native gRPC server through a colocated
+  sidecar. Choose the checkpoint, hardware and parallelism in the command
+  builder above. For compatible runtime installation and complete launch
+  examples, see the [Dynamo vLLM sidecar guide](https://github.com/ai-dynamo/dynamo/blob/main/docs/fern/pages/developer-guide/knowledge-base/modular-components/backends/vllm/sidecar.md).
+
+  The B300 deployment in [InferenceX #4231](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4231)
+  validated this integration with the original
+  [DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash checkpoint](https://huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash).
+  The builder defaults to DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017; that checkpoint was not
+  covered by this deployment's validation.
+
+  ### Connect the engine and sidecar
+
+  Use the generated model and hardware arguments with `vllm-rs serve`.
+  Add `--grpc-port 19000` and set `--reasoning-parser None`; omit the engine's
+  `--tool-call-parser` and `--enable-auto-tool-choice` flags because the
+  sidecar handles reasoning and tool parsing. For KV-aware routing, enable
+  KV events on the engine with `--kv-events-config`:
+
+  ```json
+  {"publisher":"zmq","topic":"kv-events","enable_kv_cache_events":true,"endpoint":"tcp://*:5200"}
+  ```
+
+  With etcd running, set its reachable address in each frontend and sidecar
+  shell, along with the shared request and event planes:
+
+  ```bash
+  export ETCD_ENDPOINTS=http://ETCD_HOST:2379
+  export DYN_REQUEST_PLANE=tcp DYN_EVENT_PLANE=zmq
+  ```
+
+  In a separate shell on the engine host, connect one sidecar to the engine:
+
+  ```bash
+  export DYN_VLLM_KV_EVENT_PORT=5200
+  uv run --no-project python -m dynamo.vllm.sidecar \
+    --grpc-endpoint 127.0.0.1:19000 \
+    --dyn-tool-call-parser deepseek_v41 --dyn-reasoning-parser deepseek_v41
+  ```
+
+  Start a shared frontend:
+
+  ```bash
+  uv run --no-project python -m dynamo.frontend --http-port 8000 --router-mode kv
+  ```
+
+  For disaggregated serving, follow Dynamo's launch examples to configure
+  the prefill and decode engines, NIXL KV transfer and the host's transport.
+  Add `--disaggregation-mode prefill --component prefill` to prefill sidecars
+  and `--disaggregation-mode decode` to decode sidecars. Allocate distinct
+  gRPC and KV-event ports when running several engines on the same host.
+
+  Check the frontend after the workers register:
+
+  ```bash
+  curl --fail http://FRONTEND_HOST:8000/health
+  curl --fail http://FRONTEND_HOST:8000/v1/chat/completions \

+  ```
+
+  Set the request's `model` to the served model name selected for the engine.

+  ## B300 Dynamo sidecar deployment
+
+  This deployment uses the original [DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash checkpoint](https://huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash),
+  not the newer 1017 checkpoint selected by the default builder. It follows
+  [InferenceX #4231](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4231), at
+  revision `5fafe8ccb7e4a849eadaea7703456cb0f950f89b`. The commands below are a
+  separate deployment from the builder's vLLM/SMG strategies: each engine runs
+  `vllm-rs serve`, with a colocated Dynamo gRPC sidecar and a shared KV-aware frontend.
+  Both aggregated TP4 and disaggregated DEP2-prefill/DEP8-decode layouts use
+  five-token probabilistic DSpark with block rejection and adaptive verification disabled.
+
+  ### Runtime and fabric prerequisites
+
+  Use `vllm/vllm-openai:nightly-x86_64-dev-20261012-59e75f4` on x86-64 B300 nodes.
+  Stage the original checkpoint on every worker and mount it at `/model`.
+  Reserve host memory for Engram weight offload; the frontend also budgets 8 GB
+  for its tokenizer cache. Each DEP2 prefill engine additionally reserves
+  75,161,927,680 bytes (70 GiB) per DP rank for lazy CPU KV offload.
+  Use host networking, sufficient shared memory, GPU access, and the host's EFA
+  devices in every worker container. Host EFA drivers must already be installed.
+  Install the matching Dynamo packages in the serving container without replacing vLLM:
+
+  ```bash
+  uv pip install --system --extra-index-url https://pypi.nvidia.com \
+    ai-dynamo-runtime==1.6.0.dev20261010 ai-dynamo==1.6.0.dev20261010
+  ```
+
+  For disaggregation, use [AWS EFA installer 1.50.0](https://efa-installer.amazonaws.com/aws-efa-installer-1.50.0.tar.gz)'s Ubuntu 24.04 x86-64
+  userspace packages (archive SHA256
+  `fa6dff8593d866866c13cb4640d9059835cd4efa427971f100ab40c97bef2841`).
+  Install `udev`, `libhwloc15`, the installer's `rdma-core` packages
+  (`libibverbs1`, `ibverbs-providers`, `libibumad3`, `librdmacm1`, `rdma-core`),
+  `libfabric1-aws`, and `libfabric-aws-bin`. Make `/opt/amazon/efa/lib`
+  visible to the dynamic linker and run `ldconfig`. If the NIXL LIBFABRIC
+  plugin requires `libcudart.so.12`, install `nvidia-cuda-runtime-cu12` and
+  expose that package's library directory to the linker as well.
+  Check `ldd` on `libplugin_LIBFABRIC.so` and run
+  `/opt/amazon/efa/bin/fi_info -p efa` in each container before launch.
+  See the [AWS EFA installation guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/efa-start.html).
+
+  ### Discovery and frontend
+
+  Provide a shared etcd endpoint. For a single-member service, set `INFRA_IP`
+  to its reachable host address and run an installed `etcd` binary:
+
+  ```bash
+  etcd --data-dir ./etcd-data --listen-client-urls http://0.0.0.0:2379 \
+    --advertise-client-urls "http://$INFRA_IP:2379"
+  ```
+
+  Set these values in every frontend and worker shell, substituting the etcd host:
+
+  ```bash
+  export ETCD_ENDPOINTS=http://ETCD_HOST:2379
+  export DYN_REQUEST_PLANE=tcp DYN_EVENT_PLANE=zmq PYTHONHASHSEED=0
+  ```
+
+  Run one frontend. Keep a stable `X-Dynamo-Session-ID` HTTP header across
+  turns of the same conversation to use the four-hour session affinity:
+
+  ```bash
+  export DYN_ROUTER_TEMPERATURE=0 DYN_LOG=warn
+  unset DYN_ROUTER_QUEUE_THRESHOLD
+  export DYN_TOKENIZER=fastokens DYN_TOKENIZER_CACHE=1
+  export DYN_TOKENIZER_CACHE_BYTES=8000000000
+  export DYN_ROUTER_ACTIVE_REQUEST_EXPIRY_SECS=3600
+  export DYN_TCP_CHANNEL_BUFFER=128 DYN_TCP_REQUEST_TIMEOUT=60
+  uv run --no-project python -m dynamo.frontend --http-port 8000 \
+    --router-mode kv --router-session-affinity-ttl-secs 14400
+  ```
+
+  The active-decode/prefill admission thresholds are unset in this deployment.
+  For disaggregation, the frontend can share the first decode host; give it a
+  separate CPU allocation and NUMA affinity appropriate to that machine.
+
+  ### Worker arguments
+
+  Save the following as `worker-args.sh` in each worker container. These arrays
+  hold the serving settings; the profile selector below supplies graph and batch limits.
+  The prefill and decode roles use TP1 with DP2/DP8 and expert parallelism;
+  they are independent engines, not a TP2 or TP8 process group.
+

+    --language-model-only
+    --tokenizer-mode 'deepseek_v41'

+    --tensor-parallel-size '4'
+    --engram-config '{"cpu_offload":true,"use_thp":true}'

+    --speculative-config '{"method":"dspark","num_speculative_tokens":5,"draft_sample_method":"probabilistic","rejection_sample_method":"block","enable_adaptive_verification":false}'
+    --max-model-len '1048576'

+    --attention-config '{"backend":"FLASHMLA_MEGA_ATTN_DSV41","indexer_kv_dtype":"mxfp4","indexer_sparse_logits":true}'
+    --engram-config '{"cpu_offload":true,"embedding_across_dp":true,"use_thp":false}'

+    --prefill-schedule-interval '2'

+    --max-num-seqs '168'
+    --max-num-batched-tokens '1680'
+    --compilation-config '{"cudagraph_mode":"FULL_DECODE_ONLY","max_cudagraph_capture_size":1008,"cudagraph_capture_sizes":[6,12,18,24,30,36,42,48,54,60,66,72,78,84,90,96,102,108,114,120,126,132,138,144,150,156,162,168,174,180,186,192,198,204,210,216,222,228,234,240,246,252,258,264,270,276,282,288,294,300,306,312,318,324,330,336,342,348,354,360,366,372,378,384,390,396,402,408,414,420,426,432,438,444,450,456,462,468,474,480,486,492,498,504,510,516,522,528,534,540,546,552,558,564,570,576,582,588,594,600,606,612,618,624,630,636,642,648,654,660,666,672,678,684,690,696,702,708,714,720,726,732,738,744,750,756,762,768,774,780,786,792,798,804,810,816,822,828,834,840,846,852,858,864,870,876,882,888,894,900,906,912,918,924,930,936,942,948,954,960,966,972,978,984,990,996,1002,1008]}'
+      ) ;;
+    *) echo 'Choose agg-serial, agg-batch, or pd-1 through pd-5' >&2; return 1 ;;
+  esac
+  ```
+
+  `agg-serial` sets one maximum sequence and a 4096-token budget;
+  `agg-batch` sets 32 maximum sequences and an 8192-token budget. Both use four GPUs.
+  PD profiles change the decode batch limits and graph captures while retaining
+  the same prefill settings. Place up to four independent DEP2 prefill engines
+  on an eight-GPU node. `pd-5` needs a second prefill node for its fifth engine,
+  plus the separate eight-GPU decode node.
+
+  ### Launch an engine and its sidecar
+
+  In a worker shell, source the common discovery exports and the following
+  role-specific environment. Aggregated workers need:
+
+  ```bash
+  export VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER='1'
+  export VLLM_ENGINE_READY_TIMEOUT_S='7200'
+  ```
+
+  Both disaggregated roles additionally need:
+
+  ```bash
+  export VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER='1'
+  export VLLM_ENGINE_READY_TIMEOUT_S='7200'
+  export VLLM_RPC_TIMEOUT='600000'
+  export VLLM_ALLREDUCE_USE_SYMM_MEM='0'
+  export VLLM_RANDOMIZE_DP_DUMMY_INPUTS='1'
+  export NCCL_CUMEM_ENABLE='1'
+  export UCX_TLS='cuda_copy,cuda_ipc,srd,tcp'
+  export UCX_MEMTYPE_CACHE='n'
+  export UCX_MEMTYPE_REG_WHOLE='n'
+  export UCX_RNDV_PIPELINE_ERROR_HANDLING='y'
+  export UCX_MODULE_DIR='/usr/local/lib/python3.12/dist-packages/nixl_cu13.libs/ucx'
+  export NIXL_UCX_SGL_ENABLE='0'
+  export FI_PROVIDER='efa'
+  export FI_EFA_USE_DEVICE_RDMA='1'
+  export FI_EFA_FORK_SAFE='1'
+  export DYN_SIDECAR_GRPC_STARTUP_DEADLINE_SECS='9000'
+  ```
+
+  Decode workers also set `VLLM_MAX_ASYNC_KV_ADMITS_PER_STEP=4`.
+  Keep the pinned NIXL UCX module directory; if the image is repackaged, locate
+  its equivalent rather than using a host UCX installation.
+
+  For each independent engine, set `ROLE` (`agg`, `prefill`, or `decode`),
+  `PROFILE`, `ENGINE_IP` (that engine's reachable host IP), `INSTANCE`
+  (0–3, unique among engines on one host), and `CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES`.
+  An aggregated engine uses `0,1,2,3`; a prefill engine uses one disjoint pair
+  (`0,1`, `2,3`, `4,5`, or `6,7`); decode uses all eight GPUs.
+  Each engine has its own RPC, KV-event, NIXL, HTTP and gRPC ports.
+  Keep those ports reachable between worker and frontend hosts.
+
+  Run this block once per engine, in its own shell:
+
+  ```bash
+  set -eo pipefail
+  : "${ROLE:?Set ROLE}" "${PROFILE:?Set PROFILE}" "${ENGINE_IP:?Set ENGINE_IP}"
+  : "${INSTANCE:?Set INSTANCE}" "${CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES:?Set CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES}"
+  case "$ROLE:$PROFILE" in
+    agg:agg-*|prefill:pd-*|decode:pd-*) ;;
+    *) echo "ROLE and PROFILE must select the same deployment" >&2; exit 1 ;;
+  esac
+  source worker-args.sh
+  source profiles.sh
+  export DYN_SYSTEM_PORT=$((7500 + INSTANCE))
+  export VLLM_NIXL_SIDE_CHANNEL_HOST="$ENGINE_IP"
+  export VLLM_NIXL_SIDE_CHANNEL_PORT=$((5400 + INSTANCE))
+  export DYN_VLLM_KV_EVENT_PORT=$((5200 + INSTANCE))
+  export VLLM_PLUGINS=
+  grpc_port=$((19000 + INSTANCE))
+  http_port=$((6100 + INSTANCE))
+  rpc_port=$((8400 + INSTANCE))
+  export VLLM_PORT=$((20000 + INSTANCE))
+  events=$(printf '{"publisher":"zmq","topic":"kv-events","enable_kv_cache_events":true,"endpoint":"tcp://%s:%s"}' "$ENGINE_IP" "$DYN_VLLM_KV_EVENT_PORT")
+  SIDECAR_ARGS=()
+  case "$ROLE" in
+    agg)
+      ROLE_ARGS=("${AGG_ARGS[@]}" "${PROFILE_ARGS[@]}" --kv-events-config "$events")
+      deadline=3600 ;;
+    prefill)
+      ROLE_ARGS=("${PD_ARGS[@]}" "${PREFILL_ARGS[@]}"
+        --data-parallel-size-local 2 --data-parallel-address "$ENGINE_IP"
+        --data-parallel-rpc-port "$rpc_port" --kv-events-config "$events")
+      SIDECAR_ARGS=(--disaggregation-mode prefill)
